temporal.method: Temporal PSD, Pa²/Hz, periodic Hann32, hop8, per-cell temporal mean removed; spatial pressure gauge removed per frame. Signal and error undergo identical transforms. Ratio of mean cell power is not phase/coherence or a causal noise-floor estimate.

spatial.method: Manufactured stationary spatial cosine modes. Vary low pressure coefficient; pure-low globally scales field, mixed holds high-mode coefficient1Pa. High-only measures low-mode leakage. Same grid and scalar physics. Float32-rounded exact pressure is a representability comparator, not the learned inference arithmetic floor (which accumulates physical pressure in float64).

scope: Consumed teacher-state replay and manufactured diagnostics; not independent validation, temporal dynamics intervention or training curriculum.
